purpose: Classify theorem-level external boundary leaves after Lean transitive dependency extraction without silently absorbing logical or representation-sensitive commitments into the Trusted Base.

Init.Core.note: Lean core type/equality/logical infrastructure; declaration overrides below remain stronger.

Init.Prelude.note: Lean prelude propositions, generated eliminator support, host indexing and basic definitions. Sensitive declarations may be overridden below.

Init.SimpLemmas.note: Kernel-checked prelude simplification lemmas used by elaborated proof terms.

Classical.em.reason: R theorem-closure auditing exposed an implicit proposition-decidability split in rational strict-order trichotomy. The proof was normalized to an explicit localized Classical.em site in RPreCompletionGateway; downstream principal-cut and negation proofs now reuse that gateway rather than introducing separate decisions.

Classical.propDecidable.reason: Residual guard: no accepted R proof should consume the global classical proposition-decidability instance after the explicit-trichotomy refactor. Any reappearance must be diagnosed rather than silently allowed.

propext.reason: External Lean axiom discovered by theorem-level closure. Current direct consumers are proof terms whose source uses proposition-level rewriting; refactor those proofs or explicitly justify proposition extensionality before classification.

Nat.reason: Edge provenance shows built-in Nat only as the return type of Lean-generated constructor-index declarations for BOMA inductive carriers. It is host/compiler indexing infrastructure, not the object-level BOMA natural-number carrier.

noConfusion_of_Nat.reason: Lean-generated constructor discrimination/no-confusion infrastructure consumed when BOMA proofs eliminate impossible constructor equalities. This is part of the selected inductive formalization regime, not use of built-in Nat as BOMA's mathematical carrier.
